item.text: I’m using the iquilez-sdf skill to build the ray-marched scene and orbit controls in one self-contained module.

The scene is taking shape around a teal bicycle, cream feathers, and a long golden pouch. I’m adding moving pedals with matching leg motion, plus pan and zoom controls for inspecting the rider’s contacts.

Local tool access blocked the skill-file read, so I’m proceeding with the implementation directly.
The bicycle has a connected frame, chain drive, paired fork blades, and separate spoked wheels. I’m checking the geometry bounds, pedal contacts, and camera controls before finishing the module.

The leg-motion check passes: both feet can stay on their pedals through a full turn without overextending the legs. Dragging will orbit, wheel and pinch zoom will follow the pointer, and Shift-drag or right-drag will pan for close inspection.
